name: Mercenary Vicious Cuts
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Vicious Cuts (players/thief/mercenary/vicious_cuts_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): same numbers; triggers on any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Each primary attack hit, from any weapon, has a 10% chance to take 5% of the target's current health.
